name: abel
concept: Abel, a young Innsmouth man in his twenties who still looks human: pale, thin, nervous, dark hair cut badly, a grey fisherman's sweater with holes, oilskin trousers, rubber boots, a knitted cap in his hand.
description: Pale thin nervous young man, badly cut dark hair, grey holed fisherman's sweater, dark oilskin trousers, black rubber boots.
